title: close deletes an item that an answered gate's do still names, and check then refuses that gate
goal: backlog.py close removes or repoints every gate do entry that names an item the close deletes, as it does for relates_to and depends_on, so a sync gate does not refuse the close push; a test named close_cleans_gate_do plants a gate whose do names a closing sprint's item. Found by SP-3siaqxdf's close, where BG-nhfhifpe g1 named ST-qc4vvlgs and the close push was refused.
repro_reason: the defect needs a throwaway repository with a closed sprint, and the worktree-isolation hook refuses git in a temp repository from a repro; the text match only shows the cleanup step is absent
